steps.note: S1.3.1.1 states that rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc, rows 2-5 add R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx), rows 6-7 restore a,c, so the target changes by (JV+RG)x whatever a,c are.
S1.3.1.2 gives central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero for intersections 0 and 2, and self coefficient one.
S1.3.1.3 gives central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling intersections 0 and 2, intersection one contributing 0, self coefficient (3-1)/2=1.
S1.3.1.4 gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), with the inverse schedule effecting X<-X-Y and each invocation restoring its auxiliary wires.

The plan asserts nested labels on every edge (S1.3.3, S1.3.3.4) but never states the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (the residual table); it only mentions terminal labels and the side-wire inclusion.
S1.3.3.3 gives <t_X> in t_Y^perp because t_X perp t_Y, but never states the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 nor identifies the 2->5 edge; the sub-step's dimension content is missing.
S1.3.3.4 says the only decreasing edges are center 3->4 losing h; S1.3.3.2 gives sources N and sinks Wm-N; S1.3.3.5 telescopes to Wm-2N and adds 2L for absolute changes.

S1.3.3.6 states that every nonzero F_2 residual contains a norm-one vector, hence is nondegenerate and nonalternating, hence has an orthonormal basis; the alternating-plane absorption detail is not spelled out.
S1.3.3.7 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2.
S1.3.5.1 gives the wt(z+w) identity, additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and q_V-q_U as a sum of wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis of the residual.
S1.3.5.2 states odd weight, the i^{+-[v.x]} decomposition into 1 and (-1)^{v.x}, and H diag(1,-1) H = X giving aI+bX_v or its inverse.

The plan gives one kernel per residual basis vector and s_c kernels in all (S1.3.5), but never states the k-column tensor power (C_V C_U^{-1})^{tensor k} = product of K_{e,v}^{tensor k}, i.e. one factor acting on all columns.

S1.5.1.5 only names source/sink Z signs, i^{27f} and negation of the X bank; it does not state zero-label frame I, full-label frame C^{tensor m}, C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), or C=iZC^{-1}Z, so the content is named not derived.
Plan states L/N<1/2 and the deficits N-2L_b>0 (bit) and 2N-2L_c>0 (complex), giving s<Wm in S1.3.4 and S1.3.5.
S1.3.6 states the bit relative deficit 339/22587335000000.
S1.3.6 states the complex relative deficit 73/19906842167500.
S1.3.6 states both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, log m<20, m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50), hence s/W<m^tau and m^sigma with tau=sigma=1-2^-50.
S1.3.7.1 describes elimination from the topmost nonzero row at its rightmost pivot using lower-triangular operations, one rank-one block per step, giving A=E1 Pi E2 with exactly a ones in Pi.

S1.3.7 only says q is a fixed odd prime avoiding all denominators; it does not state the finite table of factors or that the identities specialize to Z/q^b with the triangular factors staying invertible.
S1.3.7.2 states a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, each by a unit multiple plus a combination of earlier unchanged coordinates.
S1.3.7.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, one interchange of (H_i,D_j), D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, so the interchange count is exactly a.
The plan gives E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, m^10<B<m^11 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^20), but never defines nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} or C_0=128mB^2, so the constants are incomplete.
S1.5.4 method gives A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E and S1.5.4.1 gives at most E=64(W+m+1)^3 operations per invocation and at most 8e at a leaf.
S1.5.4.1 asserts the depth bound 8B^2d^12 but not the unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, and nowhere states that the total stays below C_0 d^{C_1}.
S1.5.4.2 gives values in 2^-(p+l)Z[i] of modulus at most 2^l with p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits exact; S1.5.4.3 gives 20 eps<1 so Delta=o(p).
S1.5.5 states every row of H has absolute row sum one so disk arrays map to disk arrays, and the final truncation errs by less than sqrt2 * 2^-p.

summary: P10 carries the bank-exchange derivation (B1-B4), the label-budget telescoping, orthonormal-basis and loss ratios (L3-L5), weight additivity and the translation kernel (P1-P2), all four rank-saving items (R1-R4), the elimination, triangular-cost and interchange steps of the matrix shear (M1, M3, M4), and the depth recurrence, bit widths and row-sum step of the layer (S2, S4, S5). It misses the residual table (L1), the h-2 complement on the side edge (L2), the k-column tensoring (P3), the endpoint frames and Z repair (P4), the prime/specialization argument (M2), the full constants (S1) and the unrolling (S3). 19 of 26 sub-steps present, no wrong.
